title: 59th annual Martin-Nixon rivalry game set for Saturday night at Shirley Field
excerpt: Martin High and Nixon High meet Saturday, November 7 at 7 p.m. at Shirley Field for the 59th annual Martin-Nixon football game, the oldest rivalry in town.
content:
The oldest rivalry in town takes the field again on Saturday night.

Martin High School and Nixon High School will meet in the 59th annual Martin-Nixon football game on Saturday, November 7, at 7:00 p.m. at the Shirley Field Sports Complex, according to the Laredo Independent School District.

Laredo ISD kicked off Rivalry Week festivities with a Friendship Breakfast, Proclamation Ceremony, and press conference at the LISD Performing Arts Center, where student representatives from both schools came together ahead of the game. Superintendent Guillermo Pro and Board President Goyo Lopez proclaimed the week of November 2 through November 7 as Martin-Nixon Rivalry Week at LISD.

Tickets are on sale online through GoFan. Reserved tickets are $12.00, general admission adult tickets are $10.00, and student tickets are $2.00. General admission tickets on game day will be $10.00.

The district also announced the 2026 Honorary Team Captains. For Martin High School: Maggie Martinez, LISD Assistant Superintendent for Curriculum and Instruction, from the Martin High School Class of 1987, and Raul Gomez, LISD Director of Special Education, from the Martin High School Class of 1988. For Nixon High School: Veronica Castillon, LISD Executive Director of Communications, from the Nixon High School Class of 1974, and Gaby Rogerio, LISD Executive Director of Human Resources, from the Nixon High School Class of 1987.

Parking will be available at Shirley Field, Martin High School, Christen Middle School, and Veterans Field. Parking lots open at 5:00 p.m. and stadium gates open at 5:30 p.m. Spectators are asked to use the entrance to Shirley Field on San Bernardo Avenue heading north from Park Street and the entrance to Veterans Field on Santa Maria Avenue, due to road closures in the area.

The LISD Police Department will conduct security checks at all entrances, and the district's Clear Bag Policy will be enforced. No weapons, backpacks, alcohol, or outside food and beverages will be allowed on district property. The LISD Gold Card for senior citizens and Veterans ID Card, district, and UIL passes will be accepted at the gate as general admission, and all veterans are invited to enjoy the game for free.

Sources: Laredo Independent School District, announcing Rivalry Week and the 59th annual Martin-Nixon football game on November 3, 2026.
